identification: Two Georgian/early Victorian style fob seals (chased gilt metal, one with turquoise bead and pink/amethyst glass or paste matrix, one with pale citrine-coloured stone matrix and steel ring) and an oval watch key with banded agate/carnelian panel and gilt barrel. Probably gilt metal or pinchbeck, possibly gold-cased; no marks visible.

viewing_check: Check for gold marks or a tester scratch on the mounts and the watch key barrel (9ct/15ct stamps, or pinchbeck colour). Look at the seal faces for carved intaglio (crest, motif), whether the stones are real citrine/amethyst or glass, and the turquoise bead. Check the agate panels of the key for chips and that the key socket is intact.
